name: NVDA Post-Earnings Drift: Revenue Growth Acceleration
description: Event study analyzing NVDA's price behavior in the 30 days before and after quarterly earnings, filtered to only include events where year-over-year revenue growth rate accelerated vs the prior quarter. Tracks the average cumulative return path (T-30 to T+30), window returns, post-30d distribution, and event markers showing the acceleration details.
source:
# =============================================================================
# NVDA POST-EARNINGS DRIFT: REVENUE GROWTH ACCELERATION
# =============================================================================
# Research Question: How does NVDA trade in the 30 days before and after
# earnings when quarterly YoY revenue growth is ACCELERATING vs the prior
# quarter? Only qualifying (accelerating) events are included.
#
# Methodology:
# - Asset: NVDA
# - Event filter: Quarters where current YoY revenue growth > prior quarter's
#   YoY revenue growth (acceleration). YoY = actual_revenue / previous_revenue - 1
#   (earnings.previous_revenue = same quarter prior year).
# - Window: T-30 to T+30 trading days
# - Returns: Normalized to T-1 close (T-1 = 0%)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# =============================================================================
# EARNINGS DATA & REVENUE GROWTH ACCELERATION LOGIC
# =============================================================================

earnings_data = earnings(period=EarningsPeriod.quarterly)()

# actual_revenue = current quarter revenue
# previous_revenue = same quarter prior year (built-in YoY comparison)
cur_rev = earnings_data.actual_revenue
py_rev = earnings_data.previous_revenue
had_earnings = is_valid(cur_rev)

# YoY revenue growth rate for this quarter (sparse — only on earnings dates)
yoy_growth = (cur_rev / py_rev) - 1.0

# Forward-fill YoY growth so we can lag it to get the prior quarter's value.
# Lagging by 1 on the ffill'd series gives the most-recently-reported YoY rate.
yoy_growth_filled = ffill(yoy_growth)
prior_yoy_growth = yoy_growth_filled >> 1

# Acceleration: current quarter's YoY growth > prior quarter's YoY growth
# We also require both values to be valid (i.e., not the very first observation)
is_accel = had_earnings and is_valid(prior_yoy_growth) and (yoy_growth > prior_yoy_growth)

# Count qualifying events
accel_count = 1.0 if is_accel else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# NORMALIZED RETURN COMPUTATION (relative to T-1 close)
# =============================================================================

# Base = prior day close (T-1), so T-1 = 0% by definition
base = close >> 1

ret_m30 = ((close >> 30) - base) / base
ret_m20 = ((close >> 20) - base) / base
ret_m10 = ((close >> 10) - base) / base
ret_m5  = ((close >> 5) - base) / base
ret_m1  = ((close >> 1) - base) / base   # = 0 always (anchor)
ret_0   = (close - base) / base
ret_p1  = ((close << 1) - base) / base
ret_p5  = ((close << 5) - base) / base
ret_p10 = ((close << 10) - base) / base
ret_p20 = ((close << 20) - base) / base
ret_p30 = ((close << 30) - base) / base

# =============================================================================
# WINDOW-SPECIFIC RETURNS
# =============================================================================

pre_30d = ((close >> 1) - (close >> 30)) / (close >> 30)
pre_5d  = ((close >> 1) - (close >> 5)) / (close >> 5)
earn_day = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
post_5d  = ((close << 5) - close) / close
post_30d = ((close << 30) - close) / close

# post_30d > 0 means a positive outcome: used for hit rate
post_30d_positive = 1.0 if (is_accel and (post_30d > 0.0)) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# CUMULATIVE EVENT RETURNS (earnings-day return, accumulated over time)
# =============================================================================

bar_ts = index()
accel_earn_daily = earn_day if is_accel else 0.0
cum_accel_earn = cumulative()(accel_earn_daily)

# =============================================================================
# ACCELERATION-FILTERED SERIES
# =============================================================================

# Composite return path (T-30 to T+30, normalized to T-1)
a_m30 = where(is_accel, ret_m30)
a_m20 = where(is_accel, ret_m20)
a_m10 = where(is_accel, ret_m10)
a_m5  = where(is_accel, ret_m5)
a_m1  = where(is_accel, ret_m1)
a_0   = where(is_accel, ret_0)
a_p1  = where(is_accel, ret_p1)
a_p5  = where(is_accel, ret_p5)
a_p10 = where(is_accel, ret_p10)
a_p20 = where(is_accel, ret_p20)
a_p30 = where(is_accel, ret_p30)

# Window-specific returns (for bar chart & cards)
a_pre30  = where(is_accel, pre_30d)
a_pre5   = where(is_accel, pre_5d)
a_earn   = where(is_accel, earn_day)
a_post5  = where(is_accel, post_5d)
a_post30 = where(is_accel, post_30d)

# Revenue growth details for event markers
a_yoy_cur   = where(is_accel, yoy_growth)
a_yoy_prior = where(is_accel, prior_yoy_growth)
a_yoy_delta = where(is_accel, yoy_growth - prior_yoy_growth)  # acceleration magnitude

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 1: OVERVIEW CARDS
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title='NVDA Revenue Acceleration Event Overview',
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Qualifying Events (Rev Accel)', card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, card_color=Color.Success),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Pre-30d Return', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Post-30d Return', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Earnings-Day Return', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Post-30d Hit Rate', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Overview'
)(accel_count, a_pre30, a_post30, a_earn, post_30d_positive)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 2: CUMULATIVE RETURNS
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Earnings-Day Return (Revenue Acceleration Events)',
    category='2. Cumulative Returns',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Accel Events', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(bar_ts, cum_accel_earn)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 3: COMPOSITE RETURN PATH (T-30 to T+30)
# =============================================================================

xy_bars(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Revenue Acceleration: Avg Return Path (T-30 to T+30, normalized to T-1)',
    category='3. Composite Return Path',
    x_axis_label='Offset from Earnings Date',
    y_axis_label='Avg Return vs T-1',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='T-30'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='T-20'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='T-10'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='T-5'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='T-1'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='T=0'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='T+1'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='T+5'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='T+10'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='T+20'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='T+30')
    ])
)(a_m30, a_m20, a_m10, a_m5, a_m1, a_0, a_p1, a_p5, a_p10, a_p20, a_p30)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 4: DISTRIBUTIONS
# =============================================================================

histogram(
    title='Post-30d Return Distribution (Revenue Acceleration Events)',
    category='4. Distributions',
    bins=20,
    fill_color=Color.Green,
    x_axis_label='Post-30d Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat
)(a_post30)

histogram(
    title='Earnings Day Return Distribution (Revenue Acceleration Events)',
    category='4. Distributions',
    bins=20,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    x_axis_label='Earnings Day Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat
)(a_earn)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 5: EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Revenue Acceleration Events',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Current YoY Rev Growth', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Prior Qtr YoY Rev Growth', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Acceleration (Δ YoY)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Pre-30d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Post-30d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_accel, a_yoy_cur, a_yoy_prior, a_yoy_delta, a_pre30, a_post30)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 6: WINDOW COMPARISON
# =============================================================================

xy_bars(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Revenue Acceleration: Mean Return by Window',
    category='6. Window Comparison',
    x_axis_label='Window',
    y_axis_label='Mean Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Pre-30d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Pre-5d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Earn Day'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Post-5d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Post-30d')
    ])
)(a_pre30, a_pre5, a_earn, a_post5, a_post30)
